answer: Each agent must solve a lattice-based proof-of-work keyed to a hardware enclave whose attestation signature anchors a unique identity, so a single sparrow cannot multiply into a flock without repeating costly sealed computations. Consensus weights decay toward a nadir as unverified identities accrue, forcing new entrants to harbor stake through side-channel-resistant modules. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
